gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads like looking through wide glass portholes. Righteous sits above in bent-rod letters with no hairlines, so every stroke on the page feels deliberate next to those open gaps.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-runic: Wiry, thin-looking letters that never actually thin out, led by Righteous. Righteous is best at filling the line with big bowls, while Noto Sans Runic excels at a generous x-height and curves left open.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan has a hefty lowercase and curves full of daylight inside. And under Righteous, whose strokes all end at one measured thickness, paragraphs would settle into an easy, friendly rhythm.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada keeps its c forms open and its lowercase bulky. The best thing here is how Righteous, with tails and terminals matching its main stems, gives that sturdy body a loud, friendly partner.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Righteous builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, rod-like and loud. But Noto Sans Siddham, with its large central band and far-hanging s, settles text into a friendly rhythm.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Fun comes first, from Righteous and its skeleton-like outline strokes. Noto Sans Sinhala then lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase with curve endings kept well apart, grounding the loud heading.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Righteous is all wiry, one-thickness strokes with bowls that fill the line. Noto Sans Soyombo, a sans-serif with a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curve mouths, is where the pairing wins.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads freely, with every small round letter generously unclosed and a high-waisted lowercase. And Righteous, monoline and commanding, gives that openness something sturdy to stand against on the page.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, its terminals stopping far from the stem. The pair's best trick is flat, stencil-cut Righteous against that magnified body.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Stocky and open-handed, Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses. While Righteous bends its rod-thin strokes with no heavy-to-light shift, the body's tall middle band gives lines a sturdy look.
